an3.16:1.1: Tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu apaṇṇakataṃ paṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yoni c' assa āraddhā hoti āsavānaṃ khayāya.
an3.16:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti bhojane mattaññū hoti jāgariyam anuyutto hoti.
an3.16:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti?
an3.16:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānuvyañjanaggāhī
an3.16:2.3: yatvādhikaraṇam enaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāsaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati --
an3.16:2.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānuvyañjanaggāhī
an3.16:2.9: yatvādhikaraṇam enaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāsaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati manindriyaṃ manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
an3.16:2.10: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti.
an3.16:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu bhojane mattaññū hoti?
an3.16:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti
an3.16:3.3: n' eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya, yāvad eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya: iti purāṇañ ca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañ ca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cā ti.
an3.16:3.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu bhojane mattaññū hoti.
an3.16:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu jāgariyam anuyutto hoti?
an3.16:4.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti, rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti, rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeti pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā, rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paccuṭṭhāya caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti.
an3.16:4.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti.
an3.16:4.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu apaṇṇakataṃ paṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yoni c' assa āraddhā hoti āsavānaṃ khayāyā ti. 17.
